findings.problem: No review text states that test labels are 137 up / 163 down or that a constant-down prediction scores 163/300. The only direction baseline shown is always-up 137, the minority class; adapters at 142/148/150 and Qwen base at 161 read as beating the baseline. The PDF all-300 table has no balanced accuracy (README has it). The Medium title says the adapters did not beat a simple baseline while its only test baseline is below all three adapters.
required_facts: constant-down 163/300, above all six variants, stated as a label-distribution fact and not as a pre-declared baseline
exceeding always-up is not evidence of skill; Qwen adapter 142 is below its base 161
